scope: One artificially arranged exit in an owned Windows Job, verified from frozen source and receipts.
limitations: The timing was artificially arranged; it does not prove the previous failure had the same cause.
Source and process receipts were reviewed without independent process or resource monitoring.
Only one member was sampled at peak, which does not prove both the launcher and child were observed.
Individual preflight values were not recorded; waiting pauses sampling and it is not a hard memory bound.
Prior and subsequent source checks cannot exclude transient replacement and restoration.
